title: EnterpriseSynth: Zero-Execution SFT and Evaluation Data from OpenAPI Specs
title_zh: EnterpriseSynth：基于OpenAPI规范的零执行SFT与评估数据生成

paragraphs.en: 总结：EnterpriseSynth提出零执行框架，可从OpenAPI规范生成微调与评估数据，无需调用企业API。 Tool-using large language model agents require substantial training and evaluation data, yet collecting execution traces from enterprise APIs is often unsafe, expensive, or infeasible because of access controls, compliance constraints, rate limits, and the risk of modifying production data. We present EnterpriseSynth, a zero-execution framework that converts OpenAPI specifications into supervised fine-tuning trajectories and paired evaluation instances without invoking the underlying APIs. The framework uses a four-stage pipeline for specification parsing, intent generation, trajectory synthesis, and static validation. Each generated trajectory is checked against the source specification for endpoint, parameter, type, and schema consistency before being admitted to the dataset. We evaluate EnterpriseSynth on 17 real and synthetic APIs. Adversarial refinement increases the validator's detection rate for planted schema violations from 57-80% to 98% (43/44). Across five random seeds, a compact open-weight model fine-tuned on EnterpriseSynth data outperforms both an untuned model and a Self-Instruct baseline on held-out APIs. Performance remains consistent on five private, hand-authored API specifications that were not available during training, with tool-selection accuracy of 40.0% on the private set and 39.6% on the public held-out set. However, an independent LLM-based evaluation shows that endpoint-selection accuracy substantially overestimates end-to-end correctness: accuracy falls from 48.9% under the endpoint-level metric to 21.3% when argument selection and values are also evaluated. These results demonstrate that OpenAPI specifications can support scalable, execution-free data generation, while highlighting the need for argument-level evaluation when assessing the deployment readiness of tool-using agents.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：EnterpriseSynth提出零执行框架，可从OpenAPI规范生成微调与评估数据，无需调用企业API。使用工具的大型语言模型智能体需要大量的训练与评估数据，然而由于访问控制、合规约束、速率限制以及修改生产数据的风险，从企业API收集执行轨迹往往不安全、成本高昂或不可行。 我们提出EnterpriseSynth，一个零执行框架，可在不调用底层API的情况下，将OpenAPI规范转换为监督微调轨迹和成对的评估实例。 该框架采用四阶段流水线，包括规范解析、意图生成、轨迹合成和静态验证。 每条生成的轨迹在被纳入数据集之前，都会针对端点、参数、类型和模式一致性对照源规范进行检查。 我们在17个真实和合成API上评估了EnterpriseSynth。 对抗性精炼将验证器对植入模式违规的检测率从57-80%提升至98%（43/44）。 在五个随机种子下，基于EnterpriseSynth数据微调的紧凑型开源权重模型，在保留API上的表现均优于未微调模型和Self-Instruct基线。 在五个训练期间不可用的私有、人工编写的API规范上，性能保持一致，工具选择准确率在私有集上为40.0%，在公开保留集上为39.6%。 然而，一项独立的基于LLM的评估表明，端点选择准确率大大高估了端到端正确性：当同时评估参数选择和取值时，准确率从端点级指标下的48.9%降至21.3%。 这些结果表明，OpenAPI规范可以支持可扩展的、无需执行的数据生成，同时凸显了在评估使用工具的智能体的部署就绪性时进行参数级评估的必要性。
